laws.title: Publication is representation
laws.rule: A representation.publication Record MUST remain an editorial interpretation of other Records and MUST NOT become the canonical authority for the subjects it discusses.

laws.title: Architecture is representation
laws.rule: A representation.architecture Record MUST describe responsibilities, boundaries, components or relations and MUST NOT become proof that a represented system behaves as described.

laws.title: Representations use R0.2 identity
laws.rule: Both R0.5 RecordKinds MUST use the logical identity, revision lineage, lifecycle and tombstone semantics frozen by R0.2.

laws.title: Subjects are logical identities
laws.rule: A representation MUST identify its durable subjects through RecordRef values so the represented entity remains recognizable across revisions.

laws.title: Interpretive basis is pinned
laws.rule: A representation MUST bind the exact historical Record revisions it interpreted through PinnedRecordRef basisRefs rather than silently inheriting future subject state.

laws.title: Every subject has historical basis
laws.rule: Every logical subject referenced by a representation MUST have at least one pinned basis revision of the same RecordId in that representation payload.

laws.title: Publication body is narrative not authority
laws.rule: Publication body text MAY interpret or explain Records but MUST NOT by itself create a canonical Claim, Evidence relation, lifecycle state, maturity state or public-truth verdict.

laws.title: Publication claims remain external Records
laws.rule: A Publication that exposes machine-addressable Claims MUST reference knowledge.claim Records and MUST NOT encode evidential status into the publication body or publication metadata.

laws.title: Claim references are historically grounded
laws.rule: Every Claim referenced by a Publication MUST have at least one pinned basis revision so later Claim edits cannot retroactively change what the Publication interpreted.

laws.title: Evidence basis is not evidence support
laws.rule: A Publication basisRef to evidence.artifact or evidence.binding MUST indicate historical material consulted and MUST NOT create a supports, contradicts or qualifies relation by itself.

laws.title: Evidence relations remain owned by R0.4
laws.rule: Only the R0.4 evidence.binding contract MAY encode supports, contradicts or qualifies semantics between exact Evidence and Claim or Experiment revisions.

laws.title: Architecture subjects are bounded
laws.rule: R0.5 Architecture subjects MUST resolve only to System, Investigation or Experiment Records and MUST NOT silently treat Publications, Evidence or Claims as architectural systems.

laws.title: Architecture components are local representation identifiers
laws.rule: Architecture component IDs MUST be unique only within one Architecture payload and MUST NOT be treated as global RecordIds or independent ontology entities.

laws.title: Architecture edges are representational
laws.rule: Architecture relations MUST connect local component IDs and MUST NOT create, mutate or replace canonical graph relations among the underlying Records.

laws.title: Architecture invariants are Claim references
laws.rule: An Architecture MAY reference invariant Claims but MUST NOT manufacture those propositions from diagram labels, boundaries or component text.

laws.title: Architecture Claims require pinned basis
laws.rule: Every invariant Claim referenced by Architecture MUST have an exact pinned basis revision so a later Claim revision cannot silently alter the represented invariant.

laws.title: Representation revision does not rewrite subjects
laws.rule: Changing Publication prose, Architecture components, relations, boundaries or basis MUST revise only the representation Record and MUST NOT rewrite referenced Record identities or historical revisions.

laws.title: Canonical payloads fail closed
laws.rule: R0.5 payloads MUST reject unknown fields, malformed references, missing basis coverage, invalid local components and unresolved or wrong-kind references rather than silently admitting them.

laws.title: Rendering remains implementation-neutral
laws.rule: R0.5 MUST treat Publication body as opaque editorial text and Architecture data as semantic representation without freezing a framework, markup renderer, visual layout engine or UI component model.

laws.title: Later exposure semantics remain separate
laws.rule: R0.5 MUST NOT define visibility, maturity, disclosure, public route, canonical URL, language identity or legacy migration semantics assigned to R0.6 through R0.8.

payload.title: Identity as lineage
payload.summary: A bounded editorial interpretation of one system state and one claim.
payload.body: This publication interprets pinned records without becoming their source of truth.

payload.title: Governed execution flow
payload.summary: A representation of responsibility and authority boundaries for one pinned system state.

components.label: Authority boundary
components.responsibility: Admits or rejects the proposed transition.

boundaries: Representation does not prove runtime behavior.
